name: CoinGecko
rootCause: CoinGecko reported that its third-party email platform GetResponse experienced a data breach on June 5. The compromised data includes users' names (if provided during registration), email addresses, IP addresses, and metadata related to email open locations. However, user accounts and passwords were not affected.
